<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The team lead assigned a complete Java-to-Kotlin migration task for an Elasticsearch custom Korean morphological analyzer plugin project at `/Users/admin/project/analysis-danuri`. The task (Task #3) involves migrating ~60+ Java files from `src/main/java` to `src/main/kotlin` with identical package structure, preserving functional equivalence, using Kotlin idioms, and ensuring Java interop for ES plugin compatibility.    - Kotlin idioms: companion object, when expression, null safety (?/!!/let/?.also), val/var, scope functions
   - Java Interop annotations: @JvmStatic, @JvmField, @Throws, @JvmOverloads
   - String handling: Java String.split(regex) → Kotlin split(Regex(pattern))
   - Dictionary binary compatibility (readFrom/writeTo byte-level compatibility)
   - Lucene Attribute interface/implementation conventions
   - Elasticsearch plugin architecture (NodeClient, Environment, Transport actions)
   - Korean morphological analysis (PosTag, TagProb, word extraction, tabular parsing)
   - Custom I/O layer (DataInput/DataOutput) for dictionary serialization

3. Files and Code Sections:

   **Phase 1 - com.danawa.io (COMPLETED - all 6 files)**
   - `BytesBuffer.kt` - Core byte buffer class with read/write operations, clone support
   - `CachedCharArray.kt` - ThreadLocal cached char array with SoftReference
   - `DataInput.kt` - Abstract input stream with VInt/VLong/String/generic value reading
   - `DataOutput.kt` - Abstract output stream with VInt/VLong/String/generic value writing
   - `InputStreamDataInput.kt` - InputStream wrapper for DataInput
   - `OutputStreamDataOutput.kt` - OutputStream wrapper for DataOutput

   **Phase 2 - com.danawa.util (COMPLETED - all 4 files)**
   - `CharVector.kt` - Core CharSequence implementation with ignoreCase, whitespace handling, splitByWhitespace. Uses `_offset` and `_length` private backing fields to avoid Kotlin property conflicts with CharSequence.length

   - `ResourceResolver.kt` - Resource/config file resolver (properties, YAML)
   - `SystemDictionaryCompiler.kt` - Dictionary binary compiler with main() entry point

   **Phase 3 - org.apache.lucene.analysis.tokenattributes (COMPLETED - all 6 files)**

   - `TokenInfoAttributeImpl.kt` - Implementation with CharVector ref, PosTag, state management

   - `SetDictionary.kt` - Set-based dictionary with binary read/write
   - `MapDictionary.kt` - Map-based dictionary (CharSequence -> CharSequence[])
   - `SpaceDictionary.kt` - Space/separator dictionary extending MapDictionary
   - `SynonymDictionary.kt` - Synonym dictionary with bidirectional support, merge logic
   - `CompoundDictionary.kt` - Compound noun dictionary with mainWordSet + wordSet
   - `CustomDictionary.kt` - Custom dictionary with Object[] values
   - `InvertMapDictionary.kt` - Inverted map dictionary
   - `TagProbDictionary.kt` - System dictionary implementing Dictionary<TagProb, PreResult<CharSequence>>
